notes.title: About delay of update on JS Page
notes.content:
We are sorry about delay of update. Currently we are relocating our physical address from South Korea to another country since end of last year. And our game development project is taking more time than we expected as this is our first time of releasing a game. We restarted our game project plan multiple times. Therefore update of JS Page is getting delayed.

We are expecting the update will be later of this year. The update content of JS Page will be the latest javascript engine and its frameworks. And we are expecting to put Rino.js website compiler as well. So you can compile html, javascript and css components to full static website.

Thank you

notes.title: About new update of JS Page and Price change
notes.content:
Good day, everyone!

We have been very quiet since last time. We had some problems and it has been fixed since start of this year. From this year, we were working on prototype of games, building libraries for GUI and many other things. Since some libraries are done, we are planning to update JS Page soon. It will happen later in this year or next year after releasing some products.

We are dropping support for some languages and we are going to maintain only English, Korean and Japanese.

For the last, we are going to change the price of JS Page. We are going to raise the price in next month, October 24th in Korean time.

Thank you for reading this and have a good day.

notes.title: JS Page v 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.5.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
1. JS Page record the last page that user was working. So when you start JS Page again, it will start with the page where you last visited. eg. Markdown editor -> exit JS Page -> start JS Page -> Markdown editor

2. Improved JS Page starting speed.

3. Added name of each menu. So you can have better insight what all the buttons do at the left.

4. Updated caption to give you more information. So if you place your mouse on the buttons or some area, they will give you some information.

5. Dark mode is now have white background for main part of program. Now it is more visible and prettier.

6. Now you can open console window by ctrl + j instead of ctrl + q.

7. Now dev tool can be opened from main JS Page window by F12 instead of ctrl + d

8. From this patch, reloading webpage won't place the webpage window at top.

9. The position of webpage window is recorded and will be always reloaded in the old position.

10. Added French, 繁体字 and 简体字 as language.

11. Added information section in Settings page. 

12. Fixed white area at each side of page when turning into the dark mode.


[h3]Developer's message[/h3]
We changed the plan for JS Page guide. We are going to still work on our future CMS. But it is going to take a long time to be done. So we decided to create our temporal website. The website will be called JS Page Open Web Document. Visit [url=https://jspage.geargom.org]https://jspage.geargom.org[/url]. They will be ready at some point.

Our translation of JS Page is open for everyone to update. We have chosen that way so we can give you better translation. Visit [url=https://github.com/geargom/jspg-i18n]https://github.com/geargom/jspg-i18n[/url] for add new language or update the translation.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Now we have a markdown editor! v 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.4. We are not having a huge version up because that's just numbering but there are so many changes and that's why we are putting this as a major update.


[h3]Changes[/h3]

1. From now when you write your script tags into the head tag of your HTML file, the src attribute will be "path/filename" instead of "./path/filename".

2. Markdown editor has been added. You can save your markdown content to a .md file or text file that contains HTML content which is converted from your markdown content.

We have shortcuts as well.

[list]
[*] ctrl + s: save markdown file
[*] ctrl + shift + s: save as
[*] ctrl + shift + h: save as the version that is converted to html
[*] ctrl + o: open markdown file
[*] ctrl + n: New markdown file
[/list]

You can always put your mouse pointer on the button to see the shortcut as well.

Now some people might know that the markdown editor features have shortcut as well. But they are disabled for now. Because if we enable the editor's shortcut, we cannot use some shortcut in the markdown editor page. We might change them in the future if we get too many request about it.

You can drag and drop .md file to the program for opening the .md file.

3. We are changing wording of the "Reload all" button to "Reload whole App" and "Reload web page" to "Reload webpage". And shifting down the "Reload webpage" button to above "Reload whole App". So people understand which one they should click.

We have found that some of users cannot find Reload webpage. And they have been clicking on "Reload all". We really wanted to figure that kind of human error problem out. So that's why we are changing wording and the position.

4. The order of button in HTML page has been changed. From [..., Open, File path, Save, Save as, ...] to [..., Save, Save as, Open, File path, ...].

5. From now, formatting Javascript code (Prettier code) and html (Prettier HTML) won't wipe out undo stack. You can always go back to previous version of your code and html.

[h3]Developer's message[/h3]

We understand users want a guide or tutorial. So we are building our own headless CMS because other CMS does not meet what we want to have for the user guide. However we may change the plan if we find a better solution. So in the mean time please use steam forum and guide.


Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: How to handle errors! JS Page Error 101!
notes.content:
Hi! ːsteamhappyː

We are here to tell you how to handle errors of JS Page.

1. For handling most of errors

[list]
[*] Restart JS Page, OR
[*] Click start JS Page again in Steam library, OR
[*] Save your work, press "Reload web page" or "Reload all".
[/list]

There are many type of error. JS Page program still can be unwrapping necessary files. Or Javascript code is affecting something in JS Page. So we are trying to catch them all but there are so many reasons and sometimes we cannot fix it because it might limit the use of other features. That's why we suggest restarting JS Page or reload the program GUI by the button click.

2. Report your errors to us
If you report the error of JS Page to us, we will try to fix it as soon as we have received your message. We are listening to you so just leave us a review, email or comment. We will try our best to handle the errors.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Update for JS Page v 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.2.

[h3]Changes[/h3]

1. How we handle script tags has been updated. Now you can choose whether you want to write the script tags in head for only files from same directory or every script tags that has been added. The default is "On" so if you want to add all the script(including other file paths), you should change the "Only same directory" selection to "Off" in the left menu (left sidebar). For the last, the script tag's src will be converted into "./directory.../filename", if they are from same directory of the opened HTML file. This will help people who want to  export their HTML file on live web server.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update for JS Page v 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi! Here's new update for JS Page v 1.0.1.

[h3]Changes[/h3]

1, Drag and drop feature is added. Now you can drag and drop files. File droppable area will change their color if you drag your file on them. And dropping multiple files in script tag page will add multiple script tags without type.


2. Shortcut keys are added. If you leave your mouse pointer on a button, you can find how to control JS Page with your keyboard.

ctrl + r - Run JS
ctrl + p - Prettier Code/Prettier HTML
ctrl + s - Save
ctrl + shift +s - Save As
ctrl + o - Open JS file/HTML file
ctrl + n - New JS, HTML
ctrl + w - Show HTML page
ctrl + d - developer tool
ctrl + q - console window
F5 - Reload HTML Page


3. How JS Page start setup has been changed.

Old version of JS Page was showing content of EULA 2 times. But new version of JS Page shows EULA just once when you install JS Page from steam. So if you start JS Page for first time, it will ask you to select language only.

Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:

JS Page was released yesterday. And we are happy that many people are interested in JS Page. So we decide to tell you that there will be new update for JS Page soon.

[h3]Before we talk about new feature in next update,[/h3]
we are sorry for "Early Access" text in the program. JS Page is not in "Early Access". However we did not know that we didn't remove the "Early Access" text from JS Page GUI. It is our mistake and we want to let you know that you are using the program that is fully done with what we have planned. And we are going to remove the "Early Access" text as soon as possible.

[h3]Our new feature in update will be drag and drop![/h3]
We have never planned for adding drag and drop feature. However we found that a lot of people want to use JS Page in first day of release. So we decided to add that feature to make it more convenient to use JS Page. This feature will be included in next update. So any time soon you will be adding script tags to your html file by dragging and dropping your files. And loading javascript or html file to the editor can be done by drag and drop from the next update. 

[h3]Thank you.[/h3]
We really appreciate the people who have shown their interests in JS Page. We will try our best to give you better experience for using our software. And we will bring good news next time! Thank you for reading! ːsteamhappyː
